text:
Frida: forwarding from EU account (Omar at Traduzio) — they started seeing much worse Italian + Arabic translations after the v3.4 rollout around 2026-02-27 10:12 UTC. customer says literal translations, dropped politeness markers, and occasional hallucinated dates. ticket CS-4892 attached. :rotating_light:

Priya: thanks — can you paste the customer's minimal repro and their request IDs? also which endpoint they hit?

Frida: customer pasted this (translated for thread):

  Customer sample request (POST to /v1/generate):

  ```json
  {
    "model": "redwood-v3.4",
    "input": "Traduci in italiano: 'Could you schedule the meeting for next Monday at 3pm, please?'",
    "temperature": 0.2,
    "max_tokens": 120
  }
  ```

  Customer-received response (shortened):

  ```json
  {
    "id": "resp_01F...cust",
    "output": "Puoi fissare la riunione per il 6 novembre alle 15:00?",
    "notes": "wrong date, neutral tone, literal phrasing"
  }
  ```

  They say with our previous model (v3.3) the output was: "Potresti fissare la riunione per lunedì prossimo alle 15:00, per favore?" — more polite, correct relative date.

Priya: ok — two immediate asks: (1) reproduce locally with pinned model versions, (2) check routing/fallback history and any tokenizer/ops changes in v3.4. Liam / Elena can you take? assigning now.

DeployBot: v3.4 rollout (canary) started 2026-02-27T10:05:21Z, region: eu-west-1, canary coverage: 12% -> 50% at 10:40Z.

Liam: I'm on it. I ran a quick compare with the customer's exact prompt. Repro steps below.

  Reproducer (curl):
  ```bash
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v3.3","input":"Traduci in italiano: 'Could you schedule the meeting for next Monday at 3pm, please?'","temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":120}'
  ```

  v3.3 output:
  ```json
  {"output":"Potresti fissare la riunione per lunedì prossimo alle 15:00, per favore?"}
  ```

  v3.4 output (same seed/prompt):
  ```json
  {"output":"Puoi fissare la riunione per il 6 novembre alle 15:00?"}
  ```

  Notes: v3.4 is picking an absolute date — looks like context window or system prompt handling changed for relative date resolution. Also saw slight increase in median latency (~120ms -> ~180ms) for small requests in eu-west-1.

Elena: thanks Liam — I'm checking runtime diffs. There was a patch in the tokenization pipeline to improve byte-level normalization for Arabic contexts (PR #5219) that landed right before v3.4. That might affect date tokens and spacing heuristics across languages. Also v3.4 default quantization was switched to int8-fast in canary for EU to save cost (config flag: quant_profile: "int8-fast").

Priya: both plausible leads — tokenizer change and quant profile. Which is more likely to change semantics like relative date resolution?

Liam: tokenizer change could split "next Monday" into tokens we don't recognize as relative. Quantization could change output probabilities and push the model to choose a different phrasing or hallucinated date. We need an A/B: v3.4 with old tokenization vs v3.4 with int16.

Elena: I can spin a canary slice with quant_profile: int16 and legacy_tokenizer flag set. Running now against 100 sample prompts (mix of Italian/Arabic/English relative-date prompts). Will post results in ~30m.

SupportBot: Ticket CS-4892 created and linked to thread. Customer request ID: req_0a9b.

Frida: customer is pretty upset — they flagged this as blocking release for them. They asked for an ETA on fix or rollback.

Liam: quick interim mitigation: we can add a routing rule for accounts with high-quality requirements to force model=redwood-v3.3 in eu-west-1 until we have a fix. That will add ops cost but stops regressions. Recommend doing that for Traduzio and any other customers flagged in CS.

Carlos: +1 to routing mitigation. Please confirm impact and a runbook to flip back once fixed. Also we should document the exact failing prompts to add to the regression eval suite.

Elena: initial A/B run results:

  - v3.4 (int8-fast, new tokenizer): 28/100 prompts showed semantic drift (wrong dates/omitted politeness)
  - v3.4 (int16, new tokenizer): 26/100 drift -> small improvement
  - v3.4 (int16, legacy_tokenizer): 3/100 drift -> big improvement

  Early conclusion: tokenizer change is primary culprit; quantization amplifies but isn't main cause.

Priya: great find. Action items: (1) Escalate to eng-ml to revert tokenizer tweak or adjust tokenization mapping for Italian/Arabic relative date tokens. (2) Apply routing mitigation for Traduzio (force v3.3) and notify impacted customers. (3) Add failing prompts to regression test. (4) Prepare customer-facing message.

Liam: I'll open an eng-ml issue and include diffs + sample failing tokens. Tagging @eng-ml. Also capturing sampling seeds and logits for the failing cases.

Carlos: Priya — can you draft the message to Omar? Keep it empathetic, explain mitigation (forced v3.3 routing), ETA for rollback/fix (TBD but we'll update within 48h). I'll review.

Priya: Draft to Omar (will send after review):

  "Hi Omar — thank you for the report and sorry for the disruption. We've identified a tokenizer change in the v3.4 rollout that affected some Italian and Arabic relative-date translations. As an immediate mitigation we've pinned your account to v3.3 in eu-west-1 and you should see translations return to previous behavior within minutes. Our engineering team is working on a permanent fix and we'll follow up with an update in the next 48 hours. Ticket CS-4892 remains open — please reply here if you still see issues. — Priya, Redwood Support"
Frida: customer confirmed pinned routing fixed the example output (confirmed by Omar). He asked for an explanation of why this happened; we'll give high-level and avoid internal implementation details.

Elena: created PR to revert the tokenizer mapping for relative-date tokens and added unit tests for Italian/Arabic date heuristics (PR #5298). Requesting review from eng-ml.

Liam: added failing prompts to the regressions harness (eval-suite/regressions/dates_multilang.json). Running full eval overnight.

Carlos: good work team. Once eng-ml approves PR, coordinate a targeted canary with legacy_tokenizer and int16 to validate. If green, we can re-enable broader rollout. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:

SupportBot: CS-4892 updated: status -> mitigation applied (pinned to v3.3), assigned -> eng-ml, priority -> P1.

Frida: I'll send final note to Omar with ETA placeholder and link to this thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:
